# blindsndrapery.com
> blindsndrapery.com supplies and installs custom blinds, shades, shutters and drapery across Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties, with statewide coverage in Florida for commercial projects. Every project starts with a free in-home consultation and measurement.

## About
blindsndrapery.com is a Florida window covering company serving residential and commercial customers. The whole job runs under one contract: measurement, fabrication, installation and warranty all sit with the company, so there is a single point of contact from first enquiry to final fitting.

The process starts with a short enquiry. A local technician then visits the property, brings the full sample range, measures every opening precisely, and provides a detailed written quote based on those measurements. Treatments are made to those exact dimensions and professionally installed.

## Services
- Blinds: faux wood, aluminum, vertical and mini, engineered to hold a straight line in Florida humidity.
- Shades: roller, solar, cellular, roman and zebra, from filtered daylight through to full room darkening.
- Drapery and curtains: custom panels, sheers, blackout linings, layered treatments, valances and cornices.
- Shutters: composite, wood and vinyl in full-height, café-style and tier-on-tier configurations.
- Motorized and smart home: app, voice and scheduled control on any treatment in the range.
- Repairs and maintenance: on-site repair for every major brand, including treatments supplied by other companies.
- Commercial: contract-grade window coverings for offices, hospitality, healthcare, retail and multi-family developments.

## Commercial
blindsndrapery.com handles commercial projects from a single conference room to multi-unit developments. Fabrics are available to NFPA 701 fire code standard where the specification requires it. A dedicated project manager runs the job from survey to handover, pricing from window schedules, architectural drawings or a formal RFP, and scheduling installation around trading hours or the construction programme.

## Service Area
Based in Broward County and covering Fort Lauderdale, Coral Springs, Deerfield Beach, Hollywood, Pompano Beach, Plantation, Weston, Pembroke Pines, Davie, Sunrise, Coconut Creek and Miramar.

Also serving Miami-Dade County, including Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Aventura, Doral, Kendall, Hialeah, North Miami, Sunny Isles Beach and Homestead, and Palm Beach County, including Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Boynton Beach, Jupiter, Wellington and Palm Beach Gardens.

Statewide coverage across Florida for commercial installations and multi-unit developments.
